name: doyled-it-skills
description: Michael Doyle's personal Claude Code skills.

plugins.name: nonfiction-superpowers
plugins.description: A composable workflow for nonfiction prose, plus Diataxis-based software documentation. Start prose with writing-nonfiction and software docs with writing-software-docs.

plugins.name: codegraph
plugins.description: Understand code through CodeGraph: initialize missing indexes, sync before querying, respect explicit indexing restrictions, and inspect unsupported files directly. Start with using-codegraph.

plugins.name: cross-repo-completeness
plugins.description: Map and verify a change's full surface across a multi-repo system so a change does not ship wired in one repo and missing in the others. Start with the cross-repo-completeness skill. Pairs with codegraph (its per-repo engine).

plugins.name: development-loop
plugins.description: A disciplined development loop for any feature or bugfix, single-repo or multi-repo: ground understanding in codegraph, compose the superpowers phases (brainstorm, plan, TDD, finish), and verify the full cross-repo surface. Start with the development-loop skill.

plugins.name: roadmap
plugins.description: Coordinate from one agreed roadmap.json, with a standalone HTML timeline, epic ownership and handoffs, conditional Orca operating guidance, read-only drift reporting, and dry-run-first publishing to GitLab, GitHub or Forgejo. The tool never deletes and closes only its own drift issue. Includes a merge request check, scheduled drift reporting and Claude Code hooks. Start with the roadmap skill.

plugins.name: printable-parts
plugins.description: Functional checks for 3D-printed parts, layered on text-to-cad (composed by name, never vendored): a prior-art search and a reference-model tier per device recorded before modeling, a measurable intent list per part checked on the exported mesh, a stale-file guard, cross-sections, a test-fit coupon, a print sheet, and a PreToolUse hook that gates mesh export and slicing. Start with the printable-parts skill.

plugins.name: dungeon-master-loop
plugins.description: A superpowers-style loop for running D&D 5e (2024) as a Dungeon Master: world-building and session prep as composable skills that hand named artifacts back and forth, so the world feeds prep and play feeds back into the world. Start with the dungeon-master-loop skill.
